newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Slack demand squeezes Venezuelan industry - survey.
newsitem.headline: Slack demand squeezes Venezuelan industry - survey.

text.p: Slack demand is squeezing Venezuelan industry margins and idle capacity is growing, a survey carried out by business chamber Coindustria showed, but business still remains "cautiously optimistic" about the future.
"The fall in domestic demand, the increase in service costs and the new competitive environment has helped beat down prices of final products, but not primary products," the survey said.

According to the third quarter survey of business confidence, 74 percent of the sample of 450 large, medium and small businesses said they continued to suffer from rising input prices, but only 48 percent said they passed on those increases to consumers.
That compares to 65 percent of businesses that passed on costs in the second quarter and 82 percent in the first quarter.
Idle industrial capacity also continues to increase, rising to 58.5 percent from 58 percent in the second quarter and 50 percent in the first.
Nevertheless, Venezuelan business continues to look positively towards the future, the survey said, as shown by increased training and investment.
